# Omit NA values

Remove NA values in ts-boxable objects, turning explicit into implicit
missing values.

## Usage

``` r
ts_na_omit(x)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  ts-boxable time series, an object of class `ts`, `xts`, `zoo`,
  `zooreg`, `data.frame`, `data.table`, `tbl`, `tbl_ts`, `tbl_time`,
  `tis`, `irts` or `timeSeries`.

## Value

a ts-boxable object of the same class as `x`, i.e., an object of class
`ts`, `xts`, `zoo`, `zooreg`, `data.frame`, `data.table`, `tbl`,
`tbl_ts`, `tbl_time`, `tis`, `irts` or `timeSeries`.

## Details

Note that internal NAs in `ts` time series will not be removed, as this
conflicts with the regular structure.

## See also

[ts_regular](https://docs.ropensci.org/tsbox/reference/ts_regular.md),
for the opposite, turning implicit into explicit missing values.

## Examples

``` r
x <- AirPassengers
x[c(2, 4)] <- NA

# A ts object does only know explicit NAs
ts_na_omit(x)
#>      Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec
#> 1949 112  NA 132  NA 121 135 148 148 136 119 104 118
#> 1950 115 126 141 135 125 149 170 170 158 133 114 140
#> 1951 145 150 178 163 172 178 199 199 184 162 146 166
```
